slug: 2026-06-11 Can Africa supply it's own digital infrastructure

facts.fact: The Data Landscapers register of operational, carrier-neutral colocation or hyperscale facilities says US-controlled operators run 33 facilities, dominated by Digital Realty's Teraco and iColo, 82% of them in South Africa, Nigeria and Kenya, so carrier-neutral facilities are in operation in Kenya; no facility is named and the document gives no date, so its published date is used.

note: One fact from the register description; the Microsoft-G42 region collapsed into indefinite delay in May 2026 (planned, not live); Safaricom's single data centre is not stated to rent to others or to be in Kenya.
